drivers.notes: Labels translated: Номинальная мощность = rated power (treated as RMS, as for the other Russian makers), Максимальная мощность = maximum power, Сопротивление '1+1'/'2+2 Ом' = dual 1/2 ohm coils, Установочная глубина = mounting depth, Диаметр монтажного отверстия = cut-out, Чувствительность = sensitivity (test condition not stated, so not put in spl fields). Re and Sd are not published; Cms printed without a unit (not used). Sensitivity 84,2 dB, outer diameter 317 mm, voice coil 4 in, Cms printed '0,041'. Ural news page calls the series 'real RMS 4 000 W' (https://ural-auto.ru/info/news/novinki-ot-kompanii-ural-moshhnejshie-sabvufery-serii-ultimatum/). Page shows 'Нет в наличии' (out of stock). CHECK: Re implied by the printed Qes, Bl, fs, Mms is about 2.7 ohm, high for 1+1 ohm coils (about 2 ohm expected in series); one printed value may be off.
